title: Schedule tab editor-first redesign
summary: Reorders the WebView Schedule tab around Edit Schedule as the primary workflow while preserving backend-owned schedule preview and save boundaries.
reason: Operators use the Schedule tab primarily to edit unattended processing windows, so the editor needs to be the first visible panel with immediate schedule and Launch impact context.
behavior_before: The Schedule tab led with read-only schedule metrics and evidence panels, with Edit Schedule lower on the page.
behavior_after: The Schedule tab leads with the Edit Schedule panel, embeds schedule state and Launch impact in that panel, separates bulk edit controls, and requires a successful backend preview before Save Schedule can run.
tests_added: Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_schedule_smoke.py for browser-backed Save gating and editor-first assertions.
Updated tests/webview/test_webview_schedule_smoke.py for editor-first order, Launch impact copy, bulk grouping, and Save gating.
rollback_plan: Revert the Schedule WebView partial, Schedule JS, Schedule CSS additions, targeted Schedule smoke updates, and this change packet.
notes: No backend API, schema, media policy, queue, Launch, or schedule-gate behavior changes. apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/styles.components.css had unrelated pre-existing dirty Metrics/Completed CSS edits; this change only adds Schedule editor-first styles near the existing schedule block rules.
